package_004j.name: Controlled Bad Debt, Write-off and Recovery
package_004j.status: implemented on PR #29 pending exact documentation-synchronised release gate
package_004j.receivable_formula: Issued Invoice Gross - Issued Credit Notes - Active Payment Allocations - Active Write-offs
package_004j.payment_capacity_formula: Payment Amount - Active Invoice Allocations - Active Bad-Debt Recoveries
invariants: Bad-debt case is exact tenant/customer/invoice evidence and stores no editable receivable balance.
Recommendation is immutable evidence and never changes receivable.
Write-off authorisation is separately permissioned and revalidates against current invoice outstanding.
Active write-off reduces operational receivable without mutating invoice, credit-note or payment history.
Write-off reversal is additive and restores receivable.
Recovery consumes capacity from an existing non-reversed same-currency payment receipt but does not reopen customer receivable.
Recovery reversal restores payment capacity only.
Active recovery must be reversed before source write-off or source payment reversal.
Mutation lock order for invoice bad-debt decisions is customer -> invoice -> bad-debt case/evidence.
Receivable and payment-capacity mutation decisions use locking/current reads so waits cannot fall back to stale REPEATABLE READ snapshots.
Historical statements show write-off credits and reversal debits at their real event times; recovery is not a customer receivable movement.
